name: ISE Chemicals Corporation
summary: ISE Chemicals Corporation engages in the iodine and natural gas, and metallic compound businesses in Japan. It offers iodine products, such as ISEFLO, a prilled iodine; crude iodine; potassium, sodium, and cuprous iodide, as well as hydroiodic acid. The company also provides metallic compounds, including nickel chloride, cobalt chloride, cobalt hydroxide, and tricobalt tetraoxide; and extracts and supplies natural gas to gas companies and factories. Its products are used in medical, feed additives, disinfectants, and electronic component industries. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan. ISE Chemicals Corporation is a subsidiary of AGC Inc.
